title: BSL-2 (Biosafety Level 2)
description: Moderate-risk agents (HIV, hepatitis virus, MRSA, primary human cells). Adds BSC II, sharps protocols, and 730-day refresher requirement.

quizData.question: All BSL-2 work that creates aerosols must happen…
options: Inside a Class II BSC (biosafety cabinet)

quizData.question: After using a needle for cell-line work, you must…
options: Recap the needle by hand and toss it
Drop it (uncapped) directly into a rigid sharps container

quizData.question: A 1 mL spill of HIV-positive supernatant happens inside the BSC. The first action is…
options: Open the sash and dilute with water
Cover with disinfectant-soaked towel, leave 20 min, then clean
Wipe immediately with a paper towel
Close the BSC and walk away

quizData.question: Lab coats worn for BSL-2 work must be…
BSL-2 certification expires after how long without refresher?
quizData.explanation: Most institutions require BSL-2 refresher every 24 months.
